scenes.headline: How a robot decides how much to think
scenes.sub: Flex-π denoises appearance, geometry, semantics and action in one latent space.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sonar! Flex-π is a robot policy that decides, at deployment, how much to think. Here's how one checkpoint does that.

scenes.text: RGB, 3D geometry and object semantics are denoised with the action in one shared latent space, so which streams it uses becomes a runtime flag.
scenes.say: The idea: appearance, geometry and object semantics are denoised with the action in one shared latent space, so which ones it uses becomes a runtime flag.

scenes.title: Three streams into one latent space

steps.note: one VAE, trained only on RGB, encodes depth too
steps.say: RGB frames and 3D pointmaps go through the same frozen video VAE. Trained only on colour, it already encodes depth well enough.
Object semantics come from a frozen DINO encoder, projected in by a linear adapter.
A six billion parameter model denoises all three streams jointly with the action, under shared self-attention.

steps.note: latents, never pixels: nothing is decoded
steps.say: It predicts the future as latents, not pixels. Nothing is decoded, so the policy reads its own predicted future without rendering it.

items.say: In training, whole input streams are dropped at random.
Cross-modality forcing makes it predict each modality's future even when that stream is missing, so all three stay mutually predictive.
At deployment, which streams it reads and generates is just a mask: fifty-six configurations, none of them fine-tuned.

scenes.title: Latency on an RTX 5090, same weights
scenes.note: VLA latency or WAM accuracy, chosen per deployment
scenes.say: Action only answers in sixty milliseconds. Full joint generation takes a hundred and ninety-three. You choose per deployment.

scenes.label: Self-repair gripper: all eight stages, in order
scenes.say: On the hardest task, repairing its own gripper in eight ordered stages, it finishes eleven of twenty rollouts. The best baseline, once.

scenes.text: Train three modalities to predict each other in one latent space, and which ones you use becomes a mask.

recap: One frozen VAE encodes both RGB and geometry
Forcing makes each stream predictable from the others
Action only at 60 ms, full joint at 193
scenes.say: To recap: one latent space, streams that predict each other, and a mask you set at deployment.
